title: Ford Library UFO press releases 1966 - 4525586
doc_notes: This document is a collection of press releases and correspondence from the office of Congressman Gerald R. Ford regarding UFO sightings and the subsequent Air Force investigation, containing one specific landing report.

encounters.summary: At least 40 persons, including 12 policemen, reported seeing a strange flying object guarded by four sister ships land in a swamp near Ann Arbor, Michigan.
encounters.quote: at least 40 persons, including 12 policemen, said today that they saw a strange flying object guarded by four sister ships land in a swamp
